page.content:
Emperor name the Apple series clones as a dynasty.

How Cleon connects

  • Series: Foundation (Apple series) — The Apple series centers cloned Cleons as Empire.
  • Faction: Galactic Empire — Cleon is an emperor of the Galactic Empire.

What is Cleon?

Cleon is the imperial name Asimov used for a late emperor; the Apple series turns Cleonic succession into cloned Brother Dawn, Day, and Dusk.

Key threads lead to Foundation (Apple series) and Galactic Empire.
